_comment: Route (a): a real 71-column Shopify order export (it has no tracking, carrier, scan date or delivery status columns) plus one added 'Delivery Status' column holding the value of the admin Orders 'Delivery status' filter the row was exported from. Today 2026-12-08, promise = ship date (Fulfilled at) + US 5 / CA 8 / GB 10 / AU 10 business days, 2026-11-26 closed, stall_days null. Hand-checked.

why.#2001: US, fulfilled 11-24, +5 business days skipping 11-26 = 12-02; In transit; 6 days late
why.#2002: US, fulfilled 11-25, promised 12-03; Delayed; 5 days late, so it is late first and the Delayed status is a flag
why.#2003: US, fulfilled 12-03, promised 12-10, not late; Failed delivery: shopper needs a message now, not on track
why.#2005: CA, fulfilled 12-01, +8 = 12-11; Delayed but not late yet
why.#2006: Out for delivery; Shopify's own Out for delivery notification covers it
why.#2007: Delivered and on the contacted list
why.#2009: order note mentions 'invoice'; the Notes column is the order note, never read
why.#2010: order note 'will I pay customs fees?' must NOT make it a customs hold; AU promised 12-18
why.#2011: Tracking added, promised 12-11: not late, and without scan dates nothing more can be said
why.#2012: GB, fulfilled 11-20, +10 = 12-07; No status; 1 day late. Note mentions 'Duties and taxes' and is ignored
why.#2013: two line-item rows merge into one order
why.#2014: appears in both the In transit and the Delivered export: two statuses, needs review
why.#2015: Failed delivery, promised 12-09, and the shopper already wrote in: flag it
why.#2016: no Fulfilled at date, so the rule cannot run
